answer: Stop sybils with a summit voyage: each agent earns summit standing by completing three verified work legs. Each leg must carry a timestamp from the latest unpredictable comet beacon; verifiers void a voyage with a stale timestamp and slash its bond. Forging 1,000 voyages costs 16x honest cost each: each comet timestamp fits one leg and one voyage, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents complete one voyage for undiluted fees.
